title: 第25章 唯一既是第一第26章 最纯粹的杀气
slug: 从天牢走出的魔尊她们怕了
content_zh:
在州牧公子李牧带领下，世家子弟开始清场。
没背景没师承的普通少年。
要么离开，要么当红尘路上的先头兵。
有自知之明，也不敢得罪这群世家子弟，都走了。
只有一人。
黑袍的神秘人，来到湖边，悠闲的坐在湖边一块石头上，不知道从哪里捡来的一根木棍，缠着丝线，湖边垂钓。
“这家伙谁？有人认识不？”
大家戏谑的看着黑袍神秘人。
“藏头露尾的家伙，应该有点名气，怕被认出来，怕出丑隐藏身份。”
“这种小聪明的家伙，走不远，从来都没有藏头露尾的家伙，能在红尘路上走的最远。”
“连自信都没有，没有一往无前的霸气，心性不过关。”
“在李牧公子的逼迫下，连反驳抵抗的勇气都没有，乖乖的就去当先头兵，无能之辈。”
“就让他当炮灰走第一个，红尘路先行者没有优势，反而是劣势，这次红尘路，是司情仙子第一次开启红尘路，谁也不清楚红尘路考验细节。”
红尘路炼心之路。
虽然内容都是七情六欲三千红尘。
但每次红尘路考验都有不同之处，细微的差别，就足以淘汰许多人。
没人把湖边的黑袍神秘人放在眼中。
包括红尘船上的司情仙子。
她的目光，未曾在黑袍神秘人身上停留，依旧在人群中寻找目标。
寻找夜洐。

没有。
根本没有。
他连隐龙城巡夜司都敢灭，应该是胆大包天之辈，应该不会藏头露尾。
“难道已经被抓了？还是害怕被抓，早就逃离北洲之地。”司情仙子黛眉微蹙，眸子都少了几分灵动。
“司情姐姐，时间到了，要开启红尘路？”
“开启吧。”司情仙子有气无力摆了摆手：“白忙乎了，早知道就不来了，第一次开启红尘路，都是这么一群歪瓜裂枣，一定会被其他姐妹们笑话的。”
所谓州牧公子，世家子弟，名动北洲的少年天骄，在她眼中，都是一群歪瓜裂枣。
入不了眼。
......
红尘船挂着的红灯笼，突然点亮，一阵绯红色的光晕向四周散开。
“而立之辈，退后，强势参与视为敌人。”红尘船上传来女子清冷的声音。
这是红尘路的规矩。
不允许超过三十岁的人参加。
绯红色光晕，是一件密宝，功能就是可以分辨出他人的年龄，绯红色光晕拂过岸边每个人身体，超过三十岁光晕会覆盖全身。
藏不了。
众多世家子弟的护卫纷纷后退，只留下三十岁以下的青年。
红尘船光芒大盛，流光溢彩从红尘船垂落，绚丽的光芒交织而成，凝聚成一座实质光桥。
绚丽光桥连接岸边与红尘船。
这就是红尘路。
由三千红尘气凝聚而成的桥梁。

“一炷香时间皆可入桥。”
只有一炷香时间。
时间一过，他人无法再踏入红尘路。
所有人看着红尘路。
激动兴奋，也有畏惧与退缩。
content_en:
Under the leadership of Li Mu, the son of Zhou Mu, the children of the aristocratic family began to clear the place.
An ordinary boy with no background and no teachers.
Either leave, or be the vanguard on the road of mortals.
He was self-aware and did not dare to offend these children of aristocratic families, so they all left.
There is only one person.
The mysterious man in black robe came to the lake and sat leisurely on a stone by the lake. He picked up a wooden stick from somewhere, wrapped it with silk thread, and went fishing by the lake.
"Who is this guy? Does anyone know him?"
Everyone looked at the mysterious man in black robes jokingly.
"The guy who hides his head and shows his tail must be somewhat famous. He is afraid of being recognized and hiding his identity for fear of making a fool of himself."
"Such a smart guy can't go very far. No one who hides his head or tail can go the farthest on the road of mortals."
"I don't even have self-confidence, I don't have the domineering courage to move forward, and my character is not up to par."
"Under the pressure of Mr. Li Mu, he didn't even have the courage to resist. He just went to be the vanguard, an incompetent person."
"Let him be the cannon fodder and go first. Being a pioneer on the Red Dust Road has no advantage, but a disadvantage. This is the first time Fairy Si Qing has started the Red Dust Road. No one knows the details of the test on the Red Dust Road."
The road of red dust is the road of refining the heart.
Although the content is all about the seven emotions and six desires and the three thousand mortal world.
But every test on the worldly road has its differences, and the subtle differences are enough to eliminate many people.
No one took the mysterious man in black robe by the lake seriously.
Including the Si Qing Fairy on the Red Dust Ship.
Her eyes never stopped on the mysterious man in black robe, but she was still looking for the target in the crowd.
Look for nocturnal trees.
No.
Not at all.
He dared to kill even the Hidden Dragon City Night Watch Division. He must be a bold person and would not hide his head and tail.
"Have you been caught already? Or you are afraid of being caught, so you have fled Beizhou a long time ago." Fairy Si Qing frowned slightly, and her eyes became less alert.
"Sister Si Qing, the time has come. Do you want to start the road to the world of mortals?"
"Let's start it." Fairy Si Qing waved her hand feebly: "I'm busy in vain. I knew I wouldn't come here. It's my first time to start the road of mortals. They are all such crooked people. They will definitely be laughed at by other sisters."
The so-called Prince Zhou Mu, the son of an aristocratic family, and the famous young genius in Beizhou are all a bunch of crooked melons and jujubes in her eyes.
Intolerable.
...
The red lantern hanging on the Red Dust Ship suddenly lit up, and a crimson halo spread around.
"Those who stand here should stand back and treat them as enemies if they join forces." A woman's cold voice came from the Red Dust Ship.
This is the rule of the world of mortals.
No one over thirty is allowed to attend.
The crimson halo is a secret treasure. Its function is to tell the age of others. The crimson halo brushes over the body of everyone on the shore. If you are over thirty years old, the halo will cover the whole body.
Can't hide it.
The guards of many children from aristocratic families retreated, leaving only young people under thirty years old.
The ship of mortals shines brightly, and the brilliant light falls from the ship of mortals. The brilliant lights are intertwined and condensed into a substantial light bridge.
A brilliant light bridge connects the shore to the Red Dust Boat.
This is the road of mortals.
A bridge formed by the condensed energy of three thousand red dusts.
"You can enter the bridge in just one stick of incense."
Only one stick of incense time.
Once time passes, others can no longer step into the world of mortals.
Everyone looked at the red dust road.
Excitement and excitement, but also fear and withdrawal.
